name: Tennessee

statute.name: Tennessee Public Records Act
statute.citation: T.C.A. §§ 10-7-501 et seq. (access § 10-7-503, exemptions § 10-7-504, enforcement § 10-7-505, copying § 10-7-506)

response.rule_text: RCFP says 2008 revisions added a deadline for custodians to respond, but the day count and deemed-denial rule are not in the fetched text.

fees.labor_rule: OORC Schedule of Charges (T.C.A. § 8-4-604(a)) allows labor for locating, retrieving, reviewing, redacting and reproducing; first hour free; hourly rate of the employee.
fees.copy_rule: About $0.15 per black-and-white copy and $0.50 per color copy under the Schedule; custodians may charge less or more if actual costs higher.
fees.waiver_rule: Act has no waiver provision; Schedule permits waiver only under a written custodian policy.
fees.late_penalty: Court costs and attorney fees only if refusal was willful (§ 10-7-505(g)).

residency.rule_text: RCFP quotes: any citizen of the state of Tennessee can request access; requester must be a citizen of Tennessee. 2008 study group recommended removing this, not adopted.

appeal.body: Chancery or circuit court (Office of Open Records Counsel mediates and issues opinions)
appeal.rule_text: Petition chancery/circuit court of the county where the records are, or for state records Davidson County or requester's county (T.C.A. § 10-7-505(b)); no limit in the Act, six-year limitation may apply per RCFP. OORC is an informal ombudsman, no AG role.

format_rule: Information obtainable in any format the agency maintains, including electronic (§ 8-4-604(a)(1)(A)(ii)(d)); no customized database search provision.
